methods.name: Breusch-Godfrey test for serial correlation
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 100 and 200: statistics and R2 1e-6, coefficients 1e-8 relative; p-values 1e-6 relative or 1e-12 absolute; df and n exact

methods.name: Ramsey RESET test
methods.reference: lmtest::resettest(power = 2:3, type = 'fitted' | 'regressor'); stats::lm for the augmented-model R2
quantities: R2 of the original and augmented models

methods.name: Harvey-Collier test
quantities: |t| statistic (p2a keeps the sign of the mean)
mean and standard error of the recursive residuals
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 100 and 200: statistics 1e-6 relative; p-values 1e-6 relative or 1e-12 absolute; counts exact

methods.name: Wald test of nested linear models
methods.reference: lmtest::waldtest(test = 'F' | 'Chisq'); aod::wald.test (legacy reference, equal to the Chisq form)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 100 and 200: statistics and RSS 1e-6 relative; p-values 1e-6 relative or 1e-12 absolute; counts exact

methods.name: HAC (kernel) covariance for OLS
methods.reference: sandwich::NeweyWest(lag = L, prewhite = FALSE) for Bartlett; sandwich::kernHAC(kernel =, bw = L + 1, prewhite = FALSE, adjust = FALSE) for Parzen, Quadratic Spectral, Truncated, Tukey-Hanning; NeweyWest(lag = L, prewhite = TRUE) with prewhiten = true (p2a's lag count L weights lag j by k(j / (L + 1)))
quantities: SE and covariance matrix: Bartlett (default and L = 4), Parzen, Quadratic Spectral, Truncated, Tukey-Hanning (L = 3 = kernHAC(bw = 4))
SE and covariance matrix with VAR(1) prewhitening: Bartlett L = 4 (NeweyWest(lag = 4, prewhite = TRUE))
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 100: coefficients 1e-8, SE and covariance entries 1e-6 relative; bandwidth exact

methods.name: Driscoll-Kraay covariance for pooled OLS
methods.reference: sandwich::vcovPL(cluster = ~firm, order.by = ~time, kernel = 'Bartlett', lag = 2, adjust = FALSE); plm::vcovSCC(maxlag = 2) as a cross-check
quantities: Driscoll-Kraay SEs at the default lag 2 (vcovpl_lag2 = vcovscc_lag2)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 200: coefficients 1e-8, SE 1e-6 relative; counts exact

methods.name: Quantile regression
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 100: coefficients 1e-8, SE and objective 1e-6 relative; df and n exact

methods.name: GLS with AR(1) errors
quantities: coefficients, SE, t, p and sigma at nlme's REML phi
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 50: coefficients 1e-6, SE, t and sigma 1e-5 relative; p-values 1e-5 relative or 1e-12 absolute; counts exact; phi (REML and ML), Tol::iterative(1e-6) at the profile optimum (flat maximum)
